settings.heading: The Raw House Styling
settings.subtitle: Spaces with a point of view.
settings.intro: We bring together architecture, collectible design, art and objects to create spaces that feel personal, layered and distinctive. Guided by an understanding of proportion, material and form, our styling goes beyond decoration to create thoughtful compositions that reflect the people who inhabit them.
